subject: Request: temporary GPU slot reprioritization for NimbusAI pilot
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary GPU slot reprioritization for NimbusAI pilot

Team —

Quick context: NimbusAI (pilot signing this month, DEAL-8812) needs an on-site demo and a two-week pilot that will spike steady inference throughput for their LLM reranking workload. They are part of the mid-market pilot cohort we promised a constrained latency SLO; to meet that we need extra low-latency slots in the "us-west-lowlatency" pool for the first 2 weeks of May.

Ask: Can the infra/product teams temporarily reprioritize ~32 slots from the "dev-eu-burst" carveout into us-west-lowlatency for 2027-05-03 -> 2027-05-16? This is a one-off reservation; we'll restore slots to original pools after the pilot window.

What I need for decisioning:
- Karthik: confirm whether an autoscale policy exception is needed to keep latency under 120ms when burst capacity is constrained.
- Dev: feasibility and any ops risks; estimated customer impact on existing commitments.
- Marissa/Laura: confirm pilot acceptance criteria & whether we can give a hard start date.

Attachments: proposed schedule (gpu_pool_schedule.xlsx) and a one-page exception justification (autoscale-exception-request.pdf).

If we can get alignment by EOD Thursday (4/8) I can lock the customer start date and the finance sign-off.

Thanks —
Vivek
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 11:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary GPU slot reprioritization for NimbusAI pilot

Vivek —

Short answer: yes, we likely need an autoscale policy exception. A few details:
- The us-west-lowlatency pool is tuned with conservative batching and smaller max_batch_size to meet 90–120ms P95 for our verified models. Moving 32 slots in will change the effective concurrency assumptions and could increase cold-starts if the pool loses its burst buffer.
- Exception scope: set "min_available_slots" for the pool to 48 during 5/3–5/16 and disable the "dynamic downscale" rule that would normally reclaim slots after 10m idle. That will prevent churn but costs more.
- Risk: if we pin slots and traffic drops, we risk blocking other customers' bursts. We should schedule a short canary (1 day) before the full window to validate scheduling + p95.

I'll draft the exact autoscale rule patch and a rollback plan. Dev/infra should confirm scheduling feasibility.

—Karthik
Director, Serving Runtime

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary GPU slot reprioritization for NimbusAI pilot

Vivek / Karthik —

Feasible, with constraints:
- We can reassign 32 vGPU-equivalent slots from "dev-eu-burst" to "us-west-lowlatency" for 2027-05-03 00:00 -> 2027-05-16 23:59 PT. We'll need a maintenance window to drain and move tasks: target 02:00–05:00 PT on 5/3 for minimal disruption.
- Impact: dev-eu-burst will see its burst buffer reduced by ~22% for that period. Current telemetry shows low utilization on weekdays but some spikes on EU business hours. I recommend we:
  * Run a one-day canary on 5/2 in us-west with a synthetic load matching NimbusAI's expected QPS.
  * Enable Karthik's "min_available_slots" and disable downscale for the window.
- Ops playbook: include step-by-step revert (reassign slots back, re-enable downscale) and an on-call escalation list. I'll attach a short ops checklist to the ticket.

Attachments: ops-checklist.txt (added to ticket).

If Sales can confirm exact peak QPS and model variant, we'll tune batch sizes for the canary.

—Dev
Principal Infra Engineer

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sam Hayes <sam.hayes@orbitsoft.com>, "NimbusAI - Pilot Team" <pilot@nimbus.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary GPU slot reprioritization for NimbusAI pilot

Thanks — quick alignment from Sales:
- NimbusAI confirmed they can shift the demo to 5/4 if needed (they prefer 5/3 but are flexible). Their expected peak is ~650 inference LPU/sec with the "r3-reranker" model variant.
- Acceptance criteria: P95 latency <= 120ms for the demo day and <150ms during pilot window. If we can guarantee the canary looks good, we'll lock the start date.
- Commercial: Finance is ok with a one-time pilot support surcharge; they'll need the cost estimate for pinned slots to finalize.

Action items for me: collect exact QPS traces sample and send to Karthik/Dev by EOD 4/8. I'll also prep a short customer note with the potential maintenance window and rollback policy.

—Marissa
Enterprise AE
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Hayes <sam.hayes@orbitsoft.com>, "NimbusAI - Pilot Team" <pilot@nimbus.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary GPU slot reprioritization for NimbusAI pilot — confirmation and next steps

Thanks all — summary and decisions:
- Approved: move 32 slots from dev-eu-burst -> us-west-lowlatency for 2027-05-03 -> 2027-05-16.
- Autoscale: Karthik will push the exception: set min_available_slots=48 and disable dynamic downscale during window. Karthik to provide the change diff by 4/12.
- Ops: Dev will schedule the maintenance window 5/3 02:00–05:00 PT and run a canary 5/2 with synthetic load. Ops checklist & rollback steps will be added to the ticket.
- Sales/commercial: Marissa to send QPS traces by EOD 4/8 (received) and confirm final start date with NimbusAI; finance to sign off on surcharge.
- Communication: I'll send the customer-facing maintenance note on 4/13 unless we need to move earlier.

Next steps assigned:
- Karthik: autoscale change + rollback plan (due 4/12)
- Dev: ops checklist in ticket + confirm maintenance runbook (due 4/15)
- Marissa: finalize customer note and cost estimate (due 4/12)

If anything changes or we spot a conflict with EU bursts after the canary, revert immediately. Thanks for the fast turnaround — this pilot is strategically important.

Vivek
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
